question: Does a first-party official Joseon historical record of the contemporary calendar practice provide a direct object-level or mechanical identity bridge from the word 立成法 to Kyujanggak G893 授時曆立成?

source.provider: National Institute of Korean History, Annals of the Joseon Dynasty
source.work: 世宗實錄 卷101, 世宗二十五年七月六日己未, fifth article, 1443
source.folio_label: 太白山史庫本 第32冊 第101卷 第4張 A面
source.context: 禮曹據書雲觀牒啓, court administration of eclipse predictions and training, royal acceptance 從之
relevant_hanzi_atoms: 今後日月食, 以內外篇法、《授時》ㆍ《元史》法立成法, 《大明曆》推算
若於內篇法無食分, 而於他曆法中, 雖一曆法有食分, 則除外官, 只於京中各衙門知會
《授時曆》及《回回曆》法則已具內外篇中, 不必更推
右四曆毋用於取才時, 以《七政算》內外篇及《大明曆》取才
source.korean_translation_scope: Official provided Korean reading separates an '입성법(立成法)' item in its explanatory phrasing; this is editorial segmentation and cannot certify the exact word boundaries of the underlying manuscript.

positive: An annal with a specific regnal date and folio attests contemporaneous administrative comparison among multiple named calculation routes for eclipses, with a conditional public-notification rule.
The source explicitly says Shoushi and Huihui method content was already incorporated into the inner/outer calculation books, removing the need to calculate them separately in the described workflow.
The court record is relevant to parallel-use and reform context, not a mathematical interpolation table or a row of G893.
adjudication.philological_warning: The official punctuated Chinese transcription joins 《授時》ㆍ《元史》法立成法 without sufficient original folio collation here to establish precisely which titles, compounds or independent methods the words 法立成法 separate. The Korean editorial translation is not physical glyph/punctuation authority.
forbidden_inferences: The generic word 立成法 is an exact bibliographic mention of the work 授時曆立成 at 奎貴893/GK00893_00.
All listed contemporary calculations were mechanically independent, or that their numeric table fields are identical.
A royal policy of using 内外篇 for notices proves G893 direct copying, its physical edition/impression date, local 少 radix or its six target original values.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: No direct administrative 立成法 → physical GK00893_00 title/edition/copy bridge; no direct numerical table lineage.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Locate image-original 1443 court paragraph only if its exact textual segmentation materially affects a future claim of historical method identity.
Bind G893 original same-column fraction/precision and earliest independent matching table; separately check NAAJ sixth image.

next_priority: Do not continue general same-provider court-context browsing without an identity/foliated original payoff. Prioritize original-G893 少/quantization, a genuine independently sourced printed matching table, or authenticated NAAJ sixth-fascicle image.
